method.pairedInterleaved: every timed window runs once per lane back-to-back; lane order rotates by trial and case; variant order alternates by trial; warmups use the same schedule and are retained

timedWindows.allocate: allocation-only probe of the arrays buildBinary allocates (with its fills); not subtractable from build
timedWindows.bounds: triangle AABB/centroid arrays as buildWideBvh computes them, including their allocation
timedWindows.build: buildBinary only, including its own allocations; previous tree released before the window
timedWindows.refit: binary refit of changed geometry (deformed before the window, untimed); no allocation

method.untimed: generation, reset, deform, release, validation, hashing, instantiation

perTrialGates: in-module validate() in every lane after build and after refit (counts, ranges, parent multiplicity, permutation, exact leaf/internal boxes)
exact IEEE bit hashes of triangles, bounds/centroids, topology/order and node boxes equal across lanes
build hashes identical in every trial
refit keeps topology, changes node-box hash, and sees ≥50% changed triangles
independent JS validator on the V8 tree after the first build and after the first/last refit
